changelog:
Initial release of the ifa-codesys-recipe skill.

- Manage CODESYS PLC recipes via iFA Evolution: create, modify, and deploy recipe configurations.
- Supports converting between iFA binary recipe files (.txtrecipe) and CoDeSys text format recipes.
- Allows extracting and filling cam data from *.ProdData.txtrecipe files into CoDeSys recipes.
- Includes PowerShell scripts for both conversion directions and cam data merging.
- Handles IEC type auto-detection, proper text encoding, and recipe schema validation using RecipeConfig.json.
summary: Automation skill for Ifa Codesys Recipe.
